notes.title: A Tale Told by the Victor: Pride
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!
As Rose’s journey continues, we leave [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1697850/view/6190841163202880455]Gluttony[/url]’s ravenous realm and enter [b]the Mirrorverse of Pride[/b]. 

[b]Don’t trust what you see[/b] here, travelers. Just like in the tale told by the victor — there is a lot of [b]fact twisting and pompous self-glorification[/b] here.

[h2]The Shogun[/h2]
Once a [b]powerful Shogun[/b] – who conquered lands in the name of honor and glory – the Pride clutches the Realm in his ephemeral grip. He uses his influence [b]to show himself as the only hero[/b] in his story. And there is [b]no one in the realm to challenge him[/b] over it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/9c5c2b8167a8feb7b65a8e3db3ba3a1707ab701e.png[/img]
You might think that he’s all talk, but all who thought the same way never won the duel with the ex-Shogun. Even in the afterlife, [b]the Pride is as masterful of a swordsman as he was in life[/b]. 

To keep his distance in a fight [b]he uses myriad of blades[/b], dotted across the arena and doesn’t shy away from [b]petty, underhanded tactics[/b]. If not taken seriously enough, the battle will be over in a blink of an eye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/69e3e321b3265d3f30561ab5dcbaf73c2a872542.png[/img]
And The Pride will never miss an opportunity to [b]play on your egos and insecurities to lull your vigilance[/b].

[h2]Twisted Epos[/h2]
The realm of Pride depicts [b]a surreal and highly subjective version of feudal Japan[/b] during the Samurai era. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/242285074fb12be100051bd4ccee89ac2abff999.png[/img]
In life the Pride – like most other warlords – sacrificed other’s lives for his reputation and standing. And the realm stands as [b]a silent reminder of what unsatisfiable ambitions lead to[/b]. Abandoned ruins and destroyed temples, ghost towns and green overgrowth. Each one shows the end result of a bloody feud over power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/83bd0e60e2e1a2203451b77a2034212fa8a59fcb.png[/img]
As you go deeper into the realm, more and more echoes of the Pride’s conquest will appear to thwart your progress. From burning buildings to confusing labyrinths. From deadly arrow traps to hordes of undead warriors. [b]Everything plays its dedicated role in the Pride’s twisted epos.[/b]

[h2]Ukiyo-e[/h2]
Pushing through the domain of Pride is like making your way through the desolated wastelands of unfulfilled ambitions. Here the stale [b]suffocating grays are peppered with the ghostly shades of greens[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/490d6a373357e9e1d938cb3e0a417cc462ad71fd.png[/img]
[b]The further you go[/b] and the closer you get to the Pride,[b] the more vivid and saturated the surroundings become[/b]. Freakish pinks mix with delicate deep-blues; saturated crimson adjoins abyssal blacks. And together it creates[b] an almost Ukiyo-e style experience[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/c005dd4488b7076538099609b10295244cca43f0.png[/img]
In the end, the Pride’s realm — just like all the others we’ve visited so far, — is [b]a tale as old as human society itself[/b]. After all, the Sins are primal and simple by their nature. But t[b]his realm tries to make it seem as if you are at the wrong[/b] for challenging someone as grandiose as the Shogun. And yet, the evil of concealing the truth is, arguably, worse than the deeds committed. This epos is well past due to receive it’s conclusion. And [b]there will be nothing worthy of pride, when Rose puts a final dot its the end[/b].

And now, travelers, – after visiting the realms of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1697850/view/3905246507017826020]Wrath[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1697850/view/3982938673438203791]Sloth[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1697850/view/6190841163202880455]Gluttony[/url] and Pride, – will you still be brave enough to gallop through the Underwest with Rose? To witness, what will it take the mother to save her daughter? To find out, what Sins will become the next obstruction of vengeance? To uncover, what do the other realms hide?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697850/Rose_and_Locket/

Embrace the story by wishlisting the game and joining Rose’s path of vengeance. 

Until next time, travelers!

notes.title: All-encompassing Voracity: Gluttony
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!

We continue to gallop through the Underwest, following Rose’s steps on her path of vengeance. After we’ve explored the realms of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1697850/view/3905246507017826020]Wrath[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1697850/view/3982938673438203791]Sloth[/url], the road takes us through that of boundless [b]famishment[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/c9de9b7d20be33bf6510775771b9f74201716c29.jpg[/img]

This is a realm characterized by its insatiable hunger and gluttonous nature. Acidic lakes, vulturous dwellers, and aggressively carnivorous nature — this is the ravenous domain of the [b]Gluttony[/b].

[h2]The Kingdom of All-Engrossing Famishment[/h2]

The realm belongs to the evergrowing Forest that mutates every soul, damned enough to wind up there. A little note for you, travelers: [i]once you give in to the fear of hunger, you will never be the same again[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/4d1b17d6f88ee3193f56ae7ebf153a1938c46647.jpg[/img]

The Forest’s only purpose of existence is to consume, transform and mutate any unfortunate soul into another thrall for the Sin’s hordes. Even the Lost Ones, – the smallest and most innocent spirits of the Underwest, – are doomed to this transfiguration in the endless labyrinth of Gluttony. [i]No soul is safe, no soul is unnoticed, no soul is free from the Sin’s enduring clutch[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/8f2921003b488b86f508418af3103dac3d073c7a.png[/img]

The dangers of the Forest wary from bottomless pits and treacherous landscapes to scaling waterfalls and acidic cavities. Mind your every jump, calculate your every shot, watch your every step: [i]even the smallest slip up will turn you into compost[/i].

[h2]Colours of Decay[/h2]

The domain of Gluttony will meet you with the [b]murkiness of decay[/b]. Acid green and purple, rotten gray and black, fading yellow and brown are the colors that dominate the realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/49880e9893818cf38061876a4ab47fbae6435aa2.jpg[/img]

A complete one-eighty from the dew of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1697850/view/3982938673438203791]Sloth[/url], isn’t it? [i]The sense of mustiness and staleness will drown every breath you take[/i].

[h2]The Venus Flytrap[/h2]

The Forest itself [i][b]is[/b][/i] Gluttony. The Sin, – which took the form of a carnivorous plant, – is sitting atop of the acid-washed timber, spreading the pestilence of hunger, consumption and mutation onto every unlucky dweller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/5c1923fc662ec1f07fff79a14fb13688c0bfb244.jpg[/img]

While attempting to claim the bounty don’t let the Gluttony’s appearance fool you, travelers. Despite being a plant he’s a formidable foe: cautious, cunning and well-prepared to counter-attack any uninvited guest.[i] Even the [b]Gluttony’s[/b] body seems to be just unreachable — surrounded by innumerable thralls, deadly traps and disfigured vegetation herself.[/i] 

There are yet more secrets of the Underwest to uncover. Will Rose be able to save her daughter? What kind of Sins will she meet next? What do the other realms look like? 

Embrace the story by wishlisting the game and joining Rose’s path of vengeance.

notes.title: Death in the emptiness: Sloth
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!

As we follow Rose along her path of vengeance, we delve deeper into the Underwest. After we already [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1697850/view/3905246507017826020]explored the realm of Wrath[/url], our route now takes us through a rather peculiar expanse — [b]nothingness[/b].

It is a realm characterized by its sheer emptiness. Devoid of colors, sounds, and emotions – this desolate domain belongs to [b]Sloth[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/c1c66e8c6820ef76e228d2dc78e40551f1797eef.png[/img]


[h2]Absolute Kingdom of the Silence[/h2]

Sloth radiates a luminous white glow, drawing inspiration from the dusty, neglected places of yesteryear. This place embodies sheer emptiness. And what conveys the vastness without being boring and inexpressive? [b]Clouds of course[/b]!

A realm in ruins where [i]the only purpose is to glide through as if floating aimlessly through life without passion[/i]. Drifting in-between these cloudscapes feels futile — a journey through realms devoid of meaning. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/8c7bb4ff0a013303b3bf42da529e7fbe7134968e.png[/img]

If someone enters the Sloth realm — and it’s unlikely that anyone alive will dare — all that awaits them is an [b]endless fall into a colorless abyss[/b]. [i]A little tip from the Travel guide: some travelers use coffins as means of traversal, take note.[/i]

Crumbling fortresses, skeletons of cities or abandoned houses of the long dead — [b]no one can say what these ruins were[/b]. All that awaits them is desolation and oblivion as their last remembrance fades away in the lands of inaction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/26e7503f1787f8ad8f37e36bd62c07c4fa74925a.png[/img]

[h2]Colors of nothingness[/h2]

The colors here are [b]pastel whites and blues[/b], scattered among forgotten ruins, creating an airy atmosphere.

It's a sharp change from the fiery and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1697850/view/3905246507017826020]energetic realm of Wrath[/url], overflowing with emotions. Think of it as a break! Moving from the aftermath of Wrath to the eerie stagnant air of Sloth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/b3f5d93491ed2f6b25a2e641c6263e07d127c87e.png[/img]

[i]What is Sloth itself like?[/i] The emptiness can look like anything, but Sloth chooses the most fitting appearance. The swirling clouds take on vague outlines. But it's hard to make complete sense of what's it supposed to be.

[b]However, an encounter with him can result in no less danger than that of the fire Sin[/b]. Imagine fighting in free fall without the slightest fulcrum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/fe6e17dd78fe7b4efc336275e82b63522a6dea23.png[/img]

[i]Everything enters and exits in a void here. But how will Rose transform as she leaves Sloth's domain? And which Sin will she encounter next on her journey?[/i]

Join us next time for another chapter of the Underwest Travel Guide, where we'll tell you more about the Lands of Death

Until next time, Travelers!

notes.title: Blood and fire: Wrath
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!

We continue our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1697850/announcements/detail/3713837177217112367]Underwest Travel Guide[/url]. Here the Lands of Death are divided by Seven Sins each with its own patrimony. Each patrimony is an embodiment of the Sin which controls it. Emotions, colors, sounds — all this matters in the world of Underwest.

Today we'll be visiting the first domain Rose encountered on her journey. The land of horror, hopelessness and despair the blood-red Sin of Wrath, crimson in hue stands supreme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/354d6d75d11153f6e1f7be4155ac5df6ed8484a1.png[/img]

[h2]Spectral ghost town: Wrath and its domain[/h2]

The dominion of Wrath is an old abandoned town inspired by the classic Wild West settlements of the American frontier. But the music no longer plays at the saloon, and the clock on the town tower has stopped forever at noon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/4249965eb26efa998be8a8459058de933570a8b8.png[/img]

It is a place of teeming rage where red dominates the color palette. All shades — from rust to blood — embody aggression, violence and cruelty.

Wrath flits through the mass graves of the Underworld, gathering The Lost Ones. Who knows what Wrath does with these frail souls gone astray?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/7043e373fcd0c282cfb32b3c5a91f1a282083985.png[/img]
[h2]Endless firefight[/h2]

Wrath is a classic Western villain. The thirst for blood defines his entire life (or afterlife?). Wrath is one of those who always shoots first, and asks questions later.

The embodiment of pure primordial rage, he is brutal and completely devoid of composure. His Ego blinds him, making him irrational.

He wields flames, scorching red, just like him. He's cathartic about setting his enemies on fire — ending their existence in one of the most painful ways by using fireballs like bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/354d6d75d11153f6e1f7be4155ac5df6ed8484a1.png[/img]
[h2]Red. Blood red[/h2]

Color in the world of Underwest is a key element that not only conveys the emotion of each of the Sins, but also contributes heavily to the atmosphere of the Underworld

The colors of the Wrath lands are red. This color dominates not only the location and visual design, but also all of Wrath’s dialogues. All his words seem to ooze with rage, unable to contain the hatred for all things living.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/d4819493cad8310a5349fd1bcd9f91cad2db56d8.png[/img]
[i]“I can feel your blood boiling, Rose”[/i]

The lands of the Underwest are fraught with many dangers. And meeting each Sin is a test on the verge of life and death.

Get ready, our journey through the cruel and dark lands of the Underwest is just beginning! What is the next sin that will intercept Rose from saving her daughter? In the next devlog we will talk more about another Sin! What will Sloth be like in Rose history?

Until next time, Travelers!

notes.title: Underwest Travel Guide
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/4d4c8f2096a96b8006fe2268ad1c49e3f2c971f0.png[/img]

Hello Travelers! 

Welcome to our Underwest Travel Guide, this time we're diving straight into the realm of the dead, —  the Underwest. A pivotal place where Rose fights to save her daughter, the only thing that can be dear to a hardened gunslinger like herself. 

The Underworld is a wicked and mysterious place. The Seven Sins reign supreme  and danger lurks behind every turn. Let’s get into it and take a closer look at the secrets, designs, creatures, and emotions that bring this atmospheric realm to life! 

[h2]The Underwest’'s Creation: Emotion and Color[/h2]

The Underwest is a canvas splashed with pigments that convey explicit meanings. This is the domain of the Seven Sins, each one embodying the idea and emotion behind one of these vibrant colors. 
The nature of every Sin is represented by their signature colors. For instance, Wrath's domain is violent  red. — A color long-associated with intense anger, fierceness, and passion. Or Sloth’s domain which is an ephemeral and airy blue  — symbolizing laziness and indifference, a realm where its hues obscure everything and make it nearly impossible to keep track of time. Gluttony’s world is a suffocating green, consumed by dense forests — a place as beautiful as it is dangerous where verdant tones dominate, long associated with abundance and growth.  
The intricate link between the colors and the emotions they evoke was for our choice of the palettes for the Sins. Every color you see was deliberately chosen to represent the capital vices in their respective realms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/81dbfad0418d274df1eba8738e483c7405238cc3.png[/img]

[h2]Land of the Dead[/h2]

In the Underworld, life is but a distant memory. No one truly "lives" here — it's the realm where souls of the dead go to atone. Overseen by the Grand Sins, it's a realm stuck in limbo, occupying the space between life and the afterlife. 
The Grand Sins reign supreme here, each of them controlling a section of this desolate realm. This world is nightmarish and twisted. But the Grand Sins are not the only threat in this world. There are other dangers lurking in the shadows, each and every one of them waiting to prey on unsuspecting hapless souls.
As Rose travels deeper into the heart of the Underwest she will be confronted by hordes of  apparitions — grotesque minions born from the colossal plant-like sin, Gluttony. 

[h2]The Vibes of the Underwest[/h2]

Which word can be used to describe the Underwest? Atmospheric.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/d404ec8281d1bc5a405157a9efc3d571a9343c6c.png[/img]

Every corner of the Underwest roils with an unsettling energy. It has a chilling atmosphere that wraps around you, sinking down through your bones and into your very soul. Every plane oozes the very essence of the Seven Sins, every corner of the Underwest is under their absolute power, leaving nowhere for you to hide. 

[h2]Dwellers from the Underwest [/h2]

The monsters of 'Rose & Locket' borrow a bit of their design philosophy from classic '90s shooters like Doom and Doom 2. All enemies have a specific visual design to help players single out threats amidst the chaos of combat. With many spirit-like foes, expect enemies to come from all directions, even from above, making every encounter a thrilling challenge.

[h2]Friendly souls in the Underwest?[/h2]

The Underwest is a wild and dangerous realm, especially for unwelcome guests. 
With the exception of the innocent ‘Lost Ones’ — glowing white spirits, it's a barren and hostile land under the ruthless control of the Sins. Rose will be able to meet the Lost Ones — gaining the favor of the only friendly phantoms in this hazardous world of the Underwest.  

Every step taken in the Underwest is a dance with danger, and Rose must navigate it with her lightning-quick reflexes and deadly arsenal of weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/67c33959290f1ba35a1e129ebe04c7e4f6c6e543.png[/img]

Prepare to venture deeper into the world of Rose & Locket — in our next devlog we’ll introduce you to each Grand Sin and the plains under their jurisdiction, starting with Wrath???

Until next time, Travelers!

notes.title: A Big Iron on Her Hip
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/74ae9b80412b93c3608eb9aabfe079d454f9d31c.png[/img]

[h2][b]Devlog #2: Meet Rose - The heart and soul of Rose and Locket[/b]
[/h2]

Hello everyone! 
As you may have gathered from the title of this devlog, Rose is the main character of our game:  Rose and Locket!

This is our second devlog so today we'd like to introduce her in detail, and let you all get to know a little more about the woman behind the title. We hope her unique design, personality, and role within the game’s world will capture your imagination and make you eager to learn more about her.

Let’s get into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/4d879d40d1880122629d20f3f89eed3081e463ec.png[/img]

[list]
[h2][*]The inspiration behind Rose’s style[/h2] 
[/list]
Rose, the main hero of the game, has a unique but familiar design. It’s well-known for everybody, but especially for those who have watched classic western movies. To be more precise - if you have enjoyed the legendary “The Good, The Bad and the Ugly”, you definitely remember Clint Eastwood’s character - “Man with no Name”. The poncho and hat that he wore in this movie became distinctive traits of mysterious, calm, and tough cowboys. And Rose shares these common traits both in her character and in her design choices. 

[list]
[h2][*] Crafting Rose’s color palette
[/h2][/list]
The idea behind Rose’s palette was chosen and crafted intuitively. Rose dives into the Underworld to save her daughter’s soul, and the signature tones of this place are ethereal in dark purple and white colors. Rose’s coloring is really set off by this dark, enigmatic realm. And her palette really captures the mythical essence of the Underworld.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/1e89fc5397d5a1f6e82e1671f3ab020bf6d9019e.png[/img]
[list]
[h2][*] What makes Rose.. Rose?[/h2]
[/list]
How can we describe Rose in three words? Lightning-quick, badass, but caring. 

She strides in calm, handles her business quietly, and strolls out. You know this type - the ‘cool & collected bounty hunter’. But Rose is hiding something beneath this fierce appearance, either distinctive trait that all mothers share at their core — love. Even though there is little place for love in Rose's world. Her rough and thorny exterior, much like her namesake, meant to keep most others at a distance. However, there is one small thing she holds close to her heart — she is very protective and will do absolutely anything to save her beloved daughter.

[list]
[h2][*] Rose’s arsenal: not just ANY guns
[/h2][/list]
Aside from character traits, Rose is not only a bold bounty-hunter and a loving mother - she is also very good with guns. And when we say good, we mean good. Rose has a trustworthy sidekick - her Underworld-imbued revolver. 
For a cowboy, or in our case, a cowgirl - a revolver is not just a weapon - it’s a lifeline. Rose’s starting revolver is deeply rooted in the real Wild West and inspired by the iconic Colt Peacemaker. Throughout her travels, these weapons resonate with the mysterious power of the Underworld and take on a life of their own. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/18952eb9de9aa31f7ebeccd5cfa7ed333bc97f3d.png[/img]

Rose’s revolver is swift to decimate enemy spirits, and reliable enough to stand on its own in tight spots. It complements her speed and determination, summarizing her role as a steady protector and a hair-raising fighter.

As you can see, Rose is a strong and self-assertive character that was inspired by tough cowboy tropes, but has distinctive traits that make her a special and memorable character — fascinating to observe throughout her daring adventure in the Underworld. 

Thank you for taking the time to check out our devlog, we hope you enjoyed getting to know Rose a bit better! In our next devlog we will be diving into the designs of the Underworld and the monstrous creatures that inhabit it. 

Stay tuned and follow us on social media & Discord to stay up-to-date on the latest updates and news!

notes.title: Rose & Locket - Wild West Vistas
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/7e7d3e00d38fdd4268689dd0c490cc2128a12cd2.png[/img]

Greetings, gunslingers! 

Hope you're ready for a "drawsome" Rose & Locket behind-the-scenes devlog! 

We wanted to share some insight behind the scenes of Rose and Locket’s development

The story of Rose & Locket is a tale of Rose, an ex outlaw who’s been blackmailed by an evil Spirit of the Underworld, and her odyssey through the dangerous Underwest to free her daughter's spirit, imprisoned in a silver locket. 
We want to provide players with an action packed adventure of Rose against great odds of the Underwest.

Our ambition was to craft a narrative rich in emotion encompassing themes of love, loss, and the journey in between. But we also want to weave an exhilarating adventure so unforgettable that even a humble tumbleweed couldn’t resist taking the voyage.

The visuals in Rose & Locket are distinct in their comic-like aesthetic. We went through many iterations before finally settling on an art style that we hope really ‘hits the bullseye’ for players with its aesthetic appeal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/0b1ed4dbe18abab8ac7536f95a2261b1be1d75ce.png[/img]

We drew our game inspiration from Samurai Jack by Genndy Tartakovsky, an animated series famous for its blend of action, animation, and atmosphere, as well as its own distinctive artstyle. Genndy Tartakovsky's "Samurai Jack'' art style is minimalist and geometric, using clean lines and stark light-shadow contrast. Heavily influenced by Japanese woodblock prints and manga, it leans on visual storytelling and sound design, contributing to the show's mythic quality. 

We are huge fans of minimal designs and using negative space and you can definitely see that in the Rose and Locket visuals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/5dc4f72bdfa37a417d24f02a5e7f25bfb28c7f28.png[/img]
Samurai Jack concept art
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/e82b53af095e6ba4cffe7b7543c165c9ccb102e2.jpg[/img]  
Rose and Locket art

Another major influence was Mike Mignola, the creative genius behind Hellboy! Mike Mignola's "gothic noir" style is marked by stark contrasts and simplified, yet exaggerated forms. Drawing inspiration from Lovecraftian elements, his symbolic, iconographic approach creates an eerie atmosphere. His unique blend of abstraction and storytelling and creative use of negative space have significantly impacted the comic book industry.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/177664661a4ddf0b0c82a28e55e19f9bc04565d8.png[/img]
Mike Mignola art

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/e5ad46e9292fc3b66d767454db189a0e3c495910.png[/img]
Rose and Locket art

Similarly, Ashley Wood’s style blends traditional and digital art for a layered, mixed media aesthetic. Using bold brushstrokes, muted colors with vibrant bursts, and a mix of gritty realism and abstraction, his work is distinctively raw and dynamic. His stylized characters and chaotic compositions contribute to an often unsettling mood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/2212ef5e8bc93a8f62a2feaef3bd0ed0e8c2bd09.png[/img]
Ashley Wood art

As for the general in-game design of Rose & Locket, our end goal is a harmonious dance between detail and minimalism.  We believe that leaving some room for imagination and interpretation is more compelling spelling everything out. We want you to saddle up, take the reins of your imagination, and ride alongside us through the story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/7c310bedf549f5377781e7c86007697fd1ebd2d9.jpg[/img]
Rose & Locket 

On the gameplay front we turned to the classics, finding inspiration in titles like Lucas Arts' Outlaws 1997 with its emphasis on adventure and story of revenge in the old west. It created a memorable setting and characters that stuck in our memory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/2c263b05a574eb35f9ab77c0e10867a0e5e8b70b.gif[/img]

Games like this have taught us that engaging gameplay and thoughtful design can and do stand the test of time. We are striving to lasso the spirit of these iconic games and bring it galloping into the present to bring you an engaging experience throughout your adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/ec85e613572c57d9e92c8b5c1d8490fc9146dfdc.gif[/img]

Rose & Locket's visuals emerged from years of inspiration, creativity, and developer experience, melding cinematic storytelling, action-adventure gameplay, and hand-drawn animation with cherished digital world influences. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/e0acabb2556d7306790c1ee55ada2e9349943b77.png[/img]

Today’s deep-dive into the influences behind Rose & Locket has taken us from inspiration to in-game design. We’ve delved into our art and highlighted the influences from classic titles to comic aesthetics. As we continue on this exciting journey, we eagerly look forward to sharing more about our work.

In our next devlog we’ll dive into the process behind monster, character, and weapon design in Rose & Locket. Stay tuned for an exciting glimpse into these key aspects of our game, and follow us on social media & Discord to stay up-to-date on the latest updates and news

So long for now from the Underwest!

notes.title: Devlog 1: Art and Composition in Rose and Locket
notes.content:
Hello, Underwest dwellers!

Aside from the run’n’gun action you should expect in the game, one of the things that makes Rose & Locket stand out is its comic book style. However, we didn’t just take your typical 2D plane and divide it into strips. In fact, the whole game is designed around the concept, which affects both its gameplay and dramatic presentation in many ways.
Here is a small showcase.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uRoNbsm.gif[/img]
As you can see, the gameplay area isn’t simply a blocky comic grid. In fact, the screen can take any shape, making for some beautiful scenery.
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vjskf0r.jpg[/img]
One of our favorite tricks is utilizing the panel’s “negative space” for artistic purposes, such as making the scene more striking or adding a foreboding foreground.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HwnXvaE.jpg[/img]
Reducing the space around the main character naturally draws the player’s attention to an object in the middle of the frame, making the scene more dramatic. No camera panning needed!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IgUaX1h.jpg[/img]
Of course, this also lets the game have some natural and visceral story progression without adding superfluous text boxes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lgh9Etl.gif[/img]
This trick is not just for show, as changing a panel naturally changes the shape of your battle arena, making each encounter feel special.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i32yjbF.png[/img]
Such a technique lets one shape the game as the situation demands, sometimes even dropping the whole comic thing for the sake of a good cinematic shot.

We hope you liked this sneak peek and are excited about the surprises the game has in store.
There is much more to come, so stay tuned about future updates!
See you soon, in the Underwest!

And if you want to keep a closer eye on the game, follow us on social media for all the latest news.
